summary: Add a dark mode toggle to the header of the existing todo app.
requirements: A toggle control in the app header switches the app between light and dark appearance.
The current theme is reflected immediately in the app's styling.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the toggle switches the app between light and dark appearance.
The existing todo add/toggle/remove behavior continues to work unchanged.
nonGoals: No persistence of the theme choice across reloads is required for this pass.
testChecklist: Open the app and confirm the dark mode toggle is visible in the header.
Click the toggle and confirm the appearance switches.
Confirm existing todo add/toggle/remove behavior is unaffected.
